analysis: Examined base_text units of docs/provider/cli-reference.md (lines 793-1623), a documentation file. Changes are confined per file_changes to the sandbox section: a new repeatable `setup --disk <volume>` flag (head 1256, 1270), Setup check text for work disks via statfs and /Volumes/<name> volume checks (head 1286-1301), plan/install changes (head 1309-1324, 1379, 1405), progress-event fields (head 1441-1450) and a stop-text line (head 1527). These relate to TB-013/A-019/T-061 (CLI running the downloaded add-on installer as the Mac owner). Passing operator-chosen absolute paths to the installer adds no new trust: the operator already controls arguments and the owner account; installer verification still relies on TLS plus add-on self-verification (pre-existing T-061 posture, base 1285-1292). The work disks host sandbox VM images, not the provider's prefix cache, so T-041 cache-storage constraints (CacheVolume/CacheStorage) are not implicated by the visible text. No head text lines were provided, only a truncated patch excerpt, so exact wording of the new disk checks (e.g., whether volume validation is described as a security control vs. a usability check, and whether external-volume trust caveats are stated) could not be fully verified. The doc-only nature means no code control changed in this unit; the corresponding Swift sources (SandboxSetupCommand.swift, SandboxEligibility.swift, SandboxInstaller.swift) were not supplied, so integration should check any argument escaping/path handling when --disk values are forwarded to /bin/sh install.sh (argv vs shell string) and whether TB-013 should mention work-disk paths. No regression identified.
